topic.rationale: Selected on independent merit: headline invites why and how, and the first answer (ballast rotates it) opens the stronger answer (a moving instrument can confound ocean measurements). One object supports spatially connected understanding. Frigatebirds match its wonder and have stronger direct experimental access; their aerodynamic-control/low-sleep explanation is partly unresolved. Rai has excellent social insight but the honest stationary-transfer question loses the spectacular sunken-money hook. Manuscript evacuation has greater human stakes; its current evidence supports aggregate logistics more than a safely detailed individual story. FLIP wins even if all had equal source access; engineering views and rendering familiarity earn no advantage.
